scenarios.name: Preserve the selected part template's geometry in the new document

scenario_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-template-content.opj` as its active project
the user opens the new-document template chooser
the user selects the Metric folder and the Geometry Template part
a new unsaved part document is active
its viewport displays the template's rectangular solid
its model browser contains the template's extrusion and source sketch
the original template file remains unchanged
